audit.whatIsWrong: Every side token in the level chart contradicted the why text sitting next to it. The page gave Shen levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items while whys[2] through whys[6] all describe Gangplank taking those stages.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror both read Skill / Shen / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank. The whys array already matched that; only the enum tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Skill, Shen, Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phase 'why' text was boilerplate — 'Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike', 'your core pattern starts now' — and named the wrong spikes for both champions.
audit.why: Shen's only real lane spike is level 2 Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1, 600 range) forcing Remove Scurvy out. Gangplank's spikes are keg-charge acceleration at 4-5 and Trinity Force at first item; level 6 is a wash because Stand United is a map spike, not a lane one.
audit.corrected: Phase whys rewritten to the real spikes: level 2 Shadow Dash, levels 3-5 keg control, first item Trinity Force, 2+ items barrel chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Remove Scurvy cleansing Shadow Dash's taunt — was in the content layer but never reached the full layer's phase text, and its cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s and cures crowd control, so it removes the taunt that the whole Shen pattern is built on. Timing the E to when it is down is the matchup.
audit.corrected: Taunt/cleanse interaction and the 14s late-game cooldown written into the phase whys and the late-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal mention anywhere, and the build advised stacking resistances.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both: Remove Scurvy heals through chip damage, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades; and Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so armour and MR are the wrong answer to it.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names Grievous Wounds against Remove Scurvy; the late-game text says resistances do nothing against Cannon Barrage and to buy HP instead.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Spirit's Refuge', 'Remove Scurvy' and 'Powder Kegs' — the first two are the exact Riot names and the third is only a plural of Powder Keg. No name errors.

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither side owns level 1 — he pre-places a keg on your farm path and Ki Barrier eats his first hit. Walk to CS on clean angles only.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is up at 18s — E-taunt him now and force Remove Scurvy out before his kegs stack.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gangplank must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His kegs charge faster and Parrrley crit chunks you; never dash onto a live barrel, and check the ground before every step-up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Powder Kegs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He controls the wave with kegs from 1000 range and the poke outpaces Ki Barrier — farm safe and reach 6 healthy, not with a CS lead.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force lands first — his keg combos out-burst you and Remove Scurvy cleanses your taunt.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in he one-shots off a barrel chain — carry threat 9.5/10. Frontline for your team and win with R, not the 1v1.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (sticky taunt follow-up), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Sunfire Aegis; Plated Steelcaps. Grievous Wounds blunts Remove Scurvy.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Every unpunished keg is free gold — pop stacks or he outscales you.

edits.before: With Trinity Force and Essence Reaver on his side, Gangplank's barrels hit like a truck and his global Cannon Barrage adds another layer of peel and objective control that mirrors your own R in reach. In side-lane fights, do not initiate onto him without hard CC backup — his Remove Scurvy cleanses your taunt and his barrel-chain one-shots your approach. Your role at this stage is frontline-and-global: peel your carries with Spirit's Refuge, absorb barrels with Hollow Radiance health, and keep Stand United ready for every Baron or Dragon fight. You win the game through presence and engage, not through killing Gangplank himself.
edits.after: With Trinity Force and Essence Reaver on his side, Gangplank's barrels hit like a truck and Cannon Barrage adds slow and true damage on a 120s cooldown at rank 3 — stacking resistances does nothing against it, so buy raw HP instead. In side-lane fights, do not initiate without hard CC backup: Remove Scurvy is down to 14s and cures the taunt your whole pattern is built on, and his barrel chain one-shots your approach. Your role is frontline-and-global — peel with Spirit's Refuge, and keep Stand United ready for every Baron or Dragon fight. You win through presence and engage, not by killing Gangplank himself.

notes: The full layer and content layer agreed with each other but both disagreed with the packet chart, the mirror, and the page's own whys text — so this was a coherent-looking chart that was simply wrong on all seven rows. Proposed as one atomic paired group. Echoing the mirror's open question: with Gangplank now holding four of seven stages, diff 'TRICKY' at 7.5/10 with a 50.02% win rate over 2535 games may want a second look, but I did not change diff or the ratings.
